messages.subject: Installing RpostgreSQL on windows 7
messages.body_plain:
Fairly new to R so apologies in advance but when trying to install on
Windows 7 64bit I get the following error:

**snip begins **
 installing *source* package 'RPostgreSQL' ...
ERROR: configuration failed for package 'RPostgreSQL'
* removing 'C:/Users/npmj/Documents/R/win-library/2.12/RPostgreSQL'

The downloaded packages are in
        ‘C:\Users\npmj\AppData\Local\Temp
\RtmpIjh8Z0\downloaded_packages’
Warning messages:
1: running command 'C:\PROGRA~1\R\R-212~1.2/bin/i386/R CMD INSTALL -l
"C:\Users\npmj\Documents/R/win-library/2.12"   C:\Users\npmj\AppData
\Local\Temp\RtmpIjh8Z0/downloaded_packages/RPostgreSQL_0.1-7.tar.gz'
had status 1
2: In install.packages("RPostgreSQL", type = "source") :
  installation of package 'RPostgreSQL' had non-zero exit status
** snip ends **

I am running Postgres V9.0 x86 on windows.  I get the same message
running 64bit or 32bit R and from R COMMAND INSTALL at the cmd prompt.

Any help gratefully received

thanks
